_comment: FX-WEB-01: save_webhook_log — mongo webhook_logs doc shape + WebhookLog postgres column list, both branches. Behavior transcribed from bgtasks/webhook_task.py:93-140; model columns from db/models/webhook.py:65-89. No DB available in this env; pure shapes verified against source.

activity.note: All ten value slots are wrapped in str() except retry_count, which is stored raw. Callers pass dicts for request_headers/request_body (see FX-WEB-03), so the stored text is Python repr, NOT JSON.

branches.condition: MongoConnection.get_collection('webhook_logs') returns a collection and insert succeeds
collection is None OR insert raises (log_exception(e, warning=True), mongo_save_success=False)

postgres_columns.note: log_data key 'workspace_id' binds the workspace FK attname; key 'webhook' binds the UUIDField. No other keys exist, so created_by/updated_by stay NULL.

quirk_port_as_is: Postgres fallback failures are swallowed too: a second broad except logs and returns, so a failed log write never fails the sending task.
